Author: Rajesh Bindal
Bench: Rajesh Bindal
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No.1209 Of 2025
 Vijay Madanlal Choudhary Appellant(S)
 Versus
 Central Bureau Of Investigation Respondent(S)
 O R D E R
1.

The appellant seeks bail in connection with Criminal Case No. 0300647/PW/2017 for the offences under Section 120-B read with Sections 420, 406 and 477-A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
We have taken note of the fact that this Court has already granted interim bail to the appellant on 17.05.2018.
In such view of the matter, no further orders are required.
1 CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.1209/2025 3.
Accordingly, the appeal stands disposed of by making the interim bail granted to the appellant absolute.
4. We make it clear that the appellant shall continue to cooperate with the conduct of trial.

5. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
